verdict.rationale: PII detection and redaction is a fair question for a scraping API, but the evidence pack never mentions PII detection, redaction or filtering. The documented extraction features (extract_rules, ai_query) let users choose which data to pull, but they are general-purpose building blocks, not a PII-filtering capability.

support.subject: As a data-engineer, I can automatically detect and filter personally identifiable information out of scraped content before it reaches storage
